newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesian rupiah firms ahead of general elections.
newsitem.headline: Indonesian rupiah firms ahead of general elections.

text.p: The Indonesian rupiah firmed against the dollar in moderate early trading on Tuesday ahead of the general elections on Thursday, dealers said.
Some said they were surprised by the strengthening despite ample rupiah supply in the market.
They said operators remained cautious ahead of the May 29 poll after campaign violence last week, including 142 killed in the city of Banjarmasin, in South Kalimantan.
Spot rupiah, due Friday because the central bank will have no clearing on Thursday, strengthened to 2,438.1/38.4 at 0220 GMT from a 2,437.5/38.5 open.

One dealer in Singapore attributed the relatively strong rupiah to previous fears of widespread violence, causing a build-up of long dollar positions which operators now unloaded as the rupiah remained steady.
He said operators were also seen overborrowing the rupiah on the forward market fearing a possible rupiah squeeze by Bank Indonesia if it decided to copy Thai steps to curb speculation.
However, the central bank said there was no such plan.
"Now they see the rupiah is so cheap that there is no reason to extend their long forward positions. This seem to explain the soft forward market despite some uncertainties."
Dealers had said on Monday that operators were looking for good levels to unload heavy long positions established earlier.
Tomorrow and today rupiah were quoted at 2,438.5/39.5 and 2,438.5/39.0, respectively.
One Japanese bank dealer said he was still uncertain about the market and preferred to stay square for now.
He said the dollar downside was well supported because some operators were buying the dollar on dips.
Dealers said ample rupiah pulled swap rates down across the board, with overnight swaps falling to par/0.1 and tom/next to 0.05/0.10 points from 0.50/0.75 points.
Overnight rupiah fell to 4.0/5.0 percent from 7.0/9.0.
One-month swaps edged down to 14.0/15.5 from 16.5/17.5 on Monday, two to 27.0/29.0 from 29.0/34.0, three to 40.0/42.0 from 43.0/45.0 and six to 76.0/79.0 from 84.5/86.0 points.
The central bank raised its intervention band by one point to 2,413/2,605 but lowered its conversion band by three points to 2,416/2,464 on Monday. -- Jakarta newsroom +6221 384-6364
